name: background-boxes
blurb: Skewed grid of boxes that fill with color on hover.
description: Renders 15,000-element grid with 3D skew/perspective transform. Boxes respond to hover with random color fill from a hardcoded palette. Positioned absolutely with complex transforms.
use_when: Experimental interactive background for hero sections with modest screen sizes.
avoid_when: Mobile, tablets, or performance-critical pages—rendering 15,000 DOM elements causes significant jank.
a11y: Purely decorative; hover effects are visual only with no keyboard equivalents.
